# robinhood-chain-sdk

> TypeScript SDK for Robinhood Chain: Stock Tokens, Chainlink quotes, multiplier-correct portfolios, Uniswap v3 swaps, USDG, launchpad watchers, and the sequencer firehose. hoodchain.

robinhood-chain-sdk is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
